title: How Oliver's tunes were made, with no written music
summary: Oliver's pieces grew from him starting a tune and the rhythm section falling in; with nothing on paper, replacements had trouble, and Shoffner wanted to learn to write.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
